purpose: Locks the seed-stable mainland/landform feature graph and the local constrained-synthesis layer used to turn semantic Havenwild topology into coherent LPC-compatible terrain assemblies without letting tile selection own macro geography.

adoptedPrinciples: generate semantic geography and gameplay constraints before rasterizing or selecting art
treat rivers, settlements, roads and caves as graph/features that pre-exist local decoration
use local constrained synthesis only after macro and meso structure is known
allow explicit non-Wang adjacency relationships for asymmetric LPC assemblies
keep source art licensing separate from algorithm/reference licensing

seedPolicy.stabilityInvariant: Adding or changing local detail rolls may not move existing cities, rivers, mountain massifs, cave systems or primary trade routes.

meaning.1: raised shelf, mountain base or plateau

structuralTierPolicy.invariant: Current gameplay remains Level 0/1/2 while consumers avoid hard-coding exactly three representable tiers.

landformFeatureGraph.featureIdentity: Every major generated landform owns a deterministic WorldFeatureId and may cross any number of storage partitions.
landformFeatureGraph.chunkRule: Chunks materialize the intersecting portion of pre-existing features; chunks do not invent independent macro landforms.

shapeRules: finished mountains may not be generated as one circle or ellipse
tier 2 is not a uniformly inset copy of tier 1
terraces may be offset, split, elongated or interrupted by valleys
large ranges may share ridge nodes and form connected massif systems
hydrology may cut valid notches and mandatory waterfall corridors through terraces

mainlandGuarantee.caveEntrancePreference: exposed accessible lower mountain/cliff wall with sufficient rock mass behind it

toeWidth.rule: Width and material derive from geology, coast profile, wave exposure and erosion. A sheer sea cliff may use width zero and fall directly into deeper water.

coastalCliffs.providerInvariant: Changing seasonal or biome art may not change the coastal structural boundary or navigation/collision.

cities.regionConstraint: inside or immediately adjoining the major mountainous/highland province

mainlandInvariant.siteSelection: Generate and score multiple deterministic candidates per required province, then solve all three sites together. The three required roles may not be dropped when a candidate fails.

tradeTriangle.npcSchedules: Primary routes carry deterministic merchant, courier, passenger and freight schedules.

npcTradeSimulation.nearPlayer: materialized runtime actor follows the physical route
npcTradeSimulation.farFromPlayer: abstract route schedule tracks departure, ETA, cargo and route progress without simulating every actor frame
npcTradeSimulation.materializationInvariant: Approaching a scheduled traveler materializes it at the deterministic route position implied by simulation time.
npcTradeSimulation.businessIntegration: Eligible inns, taverns, markets and later player businesses near a route can become scheduled or probabilistic stops.

expeditionNetwork.outerIslandRole: PCG mission/extraction gameplay using the same terrain, geology, hydrology, ecology, cave and provider contracts as the mainland

stowawayTravel.missedPickup: recoverable gameplay state; never a hard save lock

expeditionNetwork.missionPlannerRule: Mission objectives query real generated feature IDs such as caves, ruins, waterfalls, resource provinces and ecology regions rather than placing arbitrary objectives independently of geography.

caveConnection.subsurface: Graph-first deterministic cave systems continue through on-demand underground chunks and may connect underground rivers, chambers, ore provinces, ruins and deeper strata.
caveConnection.geometryRule: Organic cave geometry may be roughened after connectivity is guaranteed; local noise or WFC may not break required graph connections.

constraintSynthesis.scope: bounded local synthesis after semantic/topological constraints are known
solverRules: hard semantic constraints are applied before observation
same world/feature seed and same constraints produce the same result
explicit adjacency may override simple matching sockets
contradictions are reported and never silently mutate macro topology
runtime rendering consumes cached solved recipes; it does not run expensive synthesis every frame
constraintSynthesis.fallback: If a complex optional visual solve contradicts, use the deterministic canonical fallback recipe and report validation evidence; never delete a required cliff, cave, road or hydrology feature to satisfy art.

cliffContourTarget.nextRuntimeAdapter: Trace contiguous structural boundaries into segments, constrain segment cells to canonical rim/wall/foot/join roles, solve compatible visual modules, cache the result by dirty region, and suppress all per-cell generic fallbacks inside the solved footprint.

validationRequirements: exactly three primary mainland city roles exist
all three primary city pairs have at least one direct scheduled trade route
western primary city owns the outer-island expedition gateway
at least one major cave-bearing massif exists
mountain massifs have ridge spines and non-circular nested structural terraces
coastal cliffs support optional zero-width shore toes
constraint synthesis is local and cannot change macro geography
every complex structural module declares logical, visual and collision footprints
constraint results are deterministic by feature/world seed
expensive local synthesis is cached outside the per-frame renderer
